messages.context: 作为花园访客提出委托
messages.text: Listen. Glowing Mushrooms don't seem to be too good for my health. About time I tried something else. You got anything, chum?
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 听着。发光蘑菇好像不太利于健康。该试点别的了。你有吃的吗,伙计?

messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。

messages.text: You are no chum of mine.
